import subprocess,time
for f in ['c40']:
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run(['/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python','/tmp/r31rev/inh.py',f],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=570,cwd='/tmp/r31rev')
    print('#####',f,round(time.time()-t),r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-2500:]); print(r.stderr[-800:])
